newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Coms21 comes on at discount.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Coms21 comes on at discount.

text.p: Shares in high technology design group Coms21 Ltd made their debut on the Australian Stock Exchange at A$0.50, a discount to the issue price of A$0.55.
Coms21 is involved in the development and commercialisation of smartcard control management systems, wide-area link jackpot systems and interactive television games, gaming and wagering.
The company made an initial public offering of 18 million shares at 55 cents each to raise A$9.9 million, an offering which closed oversubscribed on January 3.

Coms21's subsidiary NTN Australasia Pty Ltd is a licensed supplier of NTN Communications Inc's interactive sports and trivia games used in interactive television in Australia and New Zealand. NTN's broadcast centre in Sydney delivers interactive programmes to over 120 clubs and hotels in New South Wales, Queensland and the ACT via a television signal.
